verdict.rationale: Metorial is an MCP integration and agent-tooling platform, where native scheduling of recurring jobs is a plausible capability, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no scheduler, cron, or trigger feature. Magic Skills package 'repeatable' workflows, but repeatable means reusable, not time-scheduled. The daily Slack standup bot is a developer-built sample app, and nothing shows Metorial itself running it on a schedule.
